method.arithmetic: Separate pack-count enumeration and repeated rational addition; imports no production module.
method.contract: Eligibility and warning expectations are hand-annotated from documented rules, not independently discovered user facts.
method.crossCheck: Fixed handwritten packs/units/totals/subtotals/choices check the reference as well as production.
method.revision: Invokes the actual current app approval-lookup predicate with synthetic states, including same-revision changed content; a revision-only mutant must be rejected. No browser/storage/DOM is exercised.
method.authorship: AI-assisted engineering evaluation; separate implementation does not mean independent human validation.

limits: Fixed synthetic corpus, not random coverage, exhaustive input validation or a procurement acceptance benchmark.
Reference intentionally supports only these small pack counts and bounded two-decimal terms; production boundary rejection is annotated, not reimplemented.
Does not exercise browser rendering, CSV parsing, IndexedDB, concurrent tabs, real suppliers, taxes, FX, shared freight, accessibility or user acceptance.
No time saving, customer saving, demand, adoption, production readiness or unaided personal coding ability is established.
Revision lookup is application logic evidence, not a fresh browser acceptance run. Existing browser evidence remains separate.

results.intent: The lowest nominal unit price loses after whole-pack rounding and line fees.
Minimum packs can exceed the quantity-based pack count.
A lower goods price need not have the lowest line-inclusive total.
Unprovided commercial facts warn without inventing facts; unconstrained lead time may remain unknown.
Unknown lead time cannot establish compliance with a maximum lead time.
A valid leap-day expiry is inclusive; one day expired and one day too slow both block.
Stock counts available packs: three is insufficient when four are needed, zero is explicit unavailability.
Malformed money, pack counts, dates and fees stay blocked instead of being coerced.
Exact duplicate supplier/quote/item identities block both rows, even with different row IDs.
A conflicting duplicate cannot be resolved by silently taking its cheaper version.
An unselected item leaves a subtotal rather than a completed approval.
A selected blocked line is explained but never added to the eligible subtotal.
A numerically low foreign-currency offer cannot enter a GBP total.
Rational reference and production minor-unit arithmetic agree beyond safe numeric cents.
Changed quantity needs a new review even when the whole-pack total does not change; reverting values does not revive the older revision.
